name: Color Season AI
tagline: ColorSeason studies undertone, depth, and chroma in a single daylight selfie and assigns a twelve season palette with styling notes.
description: ColorSeason maps undertone, depth, and chroma from one daylight selfie onto a twelve season palette with confidence and near miss seasons. A Decision Card keeps wear and avoid colors, and the same run opens paths into makeup, hairstyle, and face shape tools. Daily use includes one free analysis with no account. Signed in Free adds signup and check-in credits that last thirty days and cap at nine. Credit packs cost 2.90, 8.90, or 9.90 dollars and never expire. The Color Handbook is 12.90 dollars once.
